summary: A React chat can hold page actions until the user explicitly opens the destination from the relevant answer.
howTo: Set uiActionHandoff mode to manual while an overlay should stay open. Use isPageAction for custom page actions, openLabel and labelForAction for destination labels, and beforeOpen to close the overlay. A batch with navigation runs in its original order on click. Buttons are tied to the open chat and are cleared on reload. See docs/ui-action-outcomes.md.
